  How to Submit Public Comment

  Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of
  the following methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

  In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card indicating the agenda item number and submit it to
  the City Clerk prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3) minutes per person
  per item. At the Mayor’s discretion, the time limit may be shortened to allow all speakers to
  address the City Council. Please note that interactions between the City Council, City
  staff, and the public during meetings are subject to the City’s Rules of Decorum.

  Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the online public
  comment form at Public Comment. Public Comment submitted electronically by
  4:00 P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the City Council before the
  meeting for their consideration, but will not be read during the meeting. Comments
  submitted after 4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Council but may not be received
  before the meeting.

  Watch the Meeting Online

   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, May 12, 2026

  •  CALL TO ORDER

  •  ROLL CALL

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE, COMMUNITY
  SERVICES, DESIGN REVIEW, HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL
  RESOURCE, AND PLANNING COMMISSIONS

  The City solicited applications for the Civil Service, Community Services, Design
  Review, Historical Preservation and Cultural Resource and Planning Commissions for
  terms from June 1, 2026, through May 31, 2028. The Council is requested to conduct
  interviews and consider appointments to all Commissions listed at the conclusion of
  the interviews.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1.  Appoint Commissioners upon conclusion of the interviews process; and
  2.  Adjust the vacant Community Services Commission term expiration from May 31,
  2027, to May 31, 2028; and
  3.  Consider the reappointment of waitlisted incumbent Deborah Saito to the Civil
  Service Commission.

  3. ADJOURNMENT
  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 19, 2026, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter, or in person at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive,
San Gabriel, CA 91776. Materials related to an item on this Agenda, submitted to the City
Council after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on the City website.

Persons with Disabilities
Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act
of 1990.

Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of

MINUTES OF MAY 12. 2026
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Chan called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:01 P.M. on
  Tuesday, May 12, 2026, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Jorge Herrera Avila, Denise Menchaca, John Wu, Vice
  Mayor Tony Ding, and Mayor Eric L. Chan
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Martin Koczanowicz, Community Services Director
  Rebecca Perez, Human Resources/Risk Management
  Director Edward Macias, Community Development
  Director David Sanchez, and Assistant City Clerk Adam
  Yang.

I  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Assistant City Clerk Yang provided information for the public on how to view the meeting.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT- None.

  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE. COMMUNITY
  SERVICES. DESIGN REVIEW. HISTORIC PRESERVATION AND CULTURAL
  RESOURCE. AND PLANNING COMMISSIONS

  Assistant City Clerk Yang reported staff's recommendation that the City Council adjust
  the expiration date for the unscheduled vacancy on the Community Services
  Commission position from May 31, 2027, to May 31, 2028, to total three appointments
  under consideration for full two-year terms.
  Human Resources/Risk Management Director Macias presented his request that term
  of office for any new commissioner appointed to the Civil Service Commission
  commence on June 1 for new matters, but not for the completion of the matter
  currently under consideration by the Commission.

I  Interviews and appointments were as follows:

  Civil Service Commission

  Mark Ramos

  Incumbent Deborah Saito was not able to attend the interview but asked to be
  considered for reappointment.

  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 3  May 12, 2026
   A motion was made by Mayor Chan, seconded by Council Member Herrera Avila, to
  appoint Deborah Saito for a term from June 1, 2026, through May 31, 2028; and Mark
  Ramos for a term to begin on June 1, 2026, with the next new matter before the
  Commission through May 31, 2028.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  HERRERA AVILA, MENCHACA, WU, DING, CHAN
  NOES:  NONE

I  ABSTAIN:
  ABSENT:
  NONE
  NONE

  Mayra Plascencia
  Darwin Rodriguez

  A motion was made by Council Member Herrera Avila, seconded by Vice Mayor Ding,
  to appoint Yi Xing, Mayra Plascencia, and Darwin Rodriguez for full terms from June
  1, 2026, through May 31, 2028.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  HERRERA AVILA, MENCHACA, WU, DING, CHAN

  ABSENT:  NONE

  A motion was made by Council Member Herrera Avila, seconded by Council Member

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  HERRERA AVILA, MENCHACA, WU, DING, CHAN
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

I  The meeting was recessed at 7:01 P.M. and reconvened at 7:11 P.M . with all Council

  Design Review Commission

  Nasser Niktab
  Marcella Tailin

  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 3  May 12, 2026
   A motion was made by Council Member Herrera Avila, seconded by Council Member
  Menchaca, to appoint Nasser Niktab and Marcella Tailin for full terms from June 1,
  2026, through May 31, 2028.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  HERRERA AVILA, MENCHACA, WU, DING, CHAN

I  ABSENT:  NONE

  Historic Preservation and Cultural Resource Commission

  A motion was made by Council Member Menchaca, seconded by Vice Mayor Ding, to
